info.title: Orbit API
info.description: Authentication is a session cookie set by POST /auth/login (named orbit_session, or __Host-orbit_session over HTTPS). Errors use RFC 9457 problem details. A resource in a household you do not belong to is reported as 404, never 403.

get.summary: Whether creating the first account needs a setup code
get.description: True only on a new instance that has no owner yet. The code is printed once in the server log at start. It is never returned by the API.

post.description: On a new instance the first account can be created with the setup code from the server log (see GET /auth/setup). After that this is closed unless ORBIT_REGISTRATION=open. It does not sign you in.
Sets an HttpOnly session cookie. The response body never contains the session token.
Public, because the invitee has no account yet. The token travels in the body, never in the URL, so it stays out of access logs. An unknown, expired, revoked or used token all answer 404.

post.summary: Join a household with an invitation
post.description: Creates the account and adds it to the household in one step, using up the invitation. Works while registration is closed. It does not sign you in.

get.summary: How people can sign in on this instance
get.description: Public. Tells the login page whether to show the password form and the single-sign-on button.

post.summary: Start signing in with the identity provider
post.description: Returns the address to send the browser to and sets a short-lived HttpOnly cookie that the callback checks. Pass an invitation token to join a household, or the setup code for the first account of a new instance. With `link` the caller must be signed in, and the provider account is linked to them instead of signing in. 404 when no provider is configured.

get.summary: Where the identity provider sends the browser back
get.description: Not called by scripts. Checks the state cookie, exchanges the code, verifies the ID token and signs in (or links). Always answers with a small HTML page that sets the session cookie and moves on to the app, because a Strict cookie is not sent on a navigation that began at the provider. Failures go to the login page with a short `oidc` code.

200.description: HTML that continues to the app

schema.description: HTML that continues to the app

get.description: Send the feed token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Missing, malformed, unknown and revoked tokens all answer the same 404. The body is at most 64 KB and carries an ETag; send it back as If-None-Match to get a 304.

post.summary: Add an existing account to the household (owners only)

delete.summary: Remove a member (owners only). A household always keeps one owner.

post.summary: Invite someone to the household (owners only)
post.description: Returns the secret token once. Share it as a link; Orbit keeps only a hash and cannot show it again. The invitee chooses their own username and password.

get.summary: Invitations that can still be used (owners only)

post.summary: Create a read-only display feed (owners only)
post.description: Returns the secret token once. The display sends it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` to GET /feed. Orbit keeps only a hash and cannot show it again. The feed publishes exactly the chosen fields.

get.summary: Feeds that can still be read (owners only)

delete.summary: Revoke a feed (owners only). Its token stops working at once.

get.summary: One dashboard with its widgets in display order

put.summary: Set the number of columns. Wider widgets shrink to fit.

post.summary: Add a widget, by default at the end

put.summary: Move a widget so it ends up at the given index
Set how many columns a widget occupies

get.description: One entry per installed Planet, in the shape of a built-in widget definition: a type, a title and a form.

get.summary: The rendered output of a Planet widget
get.description: Access is decided by the dashboard: a dashboard of a household you do not belong to answers 404. The output is served from the last good data and never waits for the Planet’s data source, except the first time.

html.description: Escaped markup produced by the Planet template. Show it sandboxed.

updatedAt.description: When the data was last fetched successfully.

stale.description: True when the last refresh failed and older data is shown.

error.description: Why the data is stale, or why the template failed.

post.summary: Deliver data to a Planet webhook source
post.description: Public on purpose: the unguessable token in the path is the credential. Sources that declare an HMAC secret also need `x-orbit-signature: sha256=<hex>` over the raw body.

get.summary: Liveness check for containers and monitors
get.description: Says the process is up. It does not touch the database and reveals nothing else.
